problem_text:
A logistics company needs to distribute a total shipment volume across 16 different regional warehouses to maximize total expected delivery efficiency.  
The characteristics of each warehouse are as follows:  
* Warehouse A: expected delivery efficiency is 0.118, handling cost factor is 0.037, allocation bounds [0.035, 0.471]  
* Warehouse B: expected delivery efficiency is 0.162, handling cost factor is 0.170, allocation bounds [0.005, 0.771]  
* Warehouse C: expected delivery efficiency is 0.137, handling cost factor is 0.161, allocation bounds [0.065, 0.729]  
* Warehouse D: expected delivery efficiency is 0.146, handling cost factor is 0.230, allocation bounds [0.012, 0.703]  
* Warehouse E: expected delivery efficiency is 0.180, handling cost factor is 0.056, allocation bounds [0.030, 0.729]  
* Warehouse F: expected delivery efficiency is 0.161, handling cost factor is 0.018, allocation bounds [0.074, 0.612]  
* Warehouse G: expected delivery efficiency is 0.093, handling cost factor is 0.241, allocation bounds [0.045, 0.449]  
* Warehouse H: expected delivery efficiency is 0.056, handling cost factor is 0.182, allocation bounds [0.098, 0.497]  
* Warehouse I: expected delivery efficiency is 0.074, handling cost factor is 0.080, allocation bounds [0.081, 0.649]  
* Warehouse J: expected delivery efficiency is 0.027, handling cost factor is 0.235, allocation bounds [0.099, 0.794]  
* Warehouse K: expected delivery efficiency is 0.080, handling cost factor is 0.221, allocation bounds [0.057, 0.517]  
* Warehouse L: expected delivery efficiency is 0.151, handling cost factor is 0.296, allocation bounds [0.089, 0.359]  
* Warehouse M: expected delivery efficiency is 0.153, handling cost factor is 0.042, allocation bounds [0.063, 0.727]  
* Warehouse N: expected delivery efficiency is 0.043, handling cost factor is 0.027, allocation bounds [0.053, 0.797]  
* Warehouse O: expected delivery efficiency is 0.199, handling cost factor is 0.118, allocation bounds [0.060, 0.349]  
* Warehouse P: expected delivery efficiency is 0.071, handling cost factor is 0.192, allocation bounds [0.035, 0.337]  

Each warehouse must receive a proportion of the total shipment volume that lies within its specified allocation bounds, and the sum of all allocation proportions must equal one.  
To ensure operational readiness, the company requires that the group of high-priority warehouses, represented by the subset HP = {E, H, L}, collectively receive at least 0.232 of the total shipment volume.  
Additionally, the overall handling cost index for the entire distribution plan must not exceed 0.184, and the total expected delivery efficiency must be no less than 0.101.  
Determine the optimal shipment allocation weights that maximize total expected delivery efficiency while satisfying all constraints.
